cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.act_name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.primary_instrument: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 25/26
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Any establishment discharging trade effluent or sewage, or drawing/using water in a manner covered by Section 25

instrument_spo_chain.o: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 25/26

instrument_spo_chain.s: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 25/26
Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 25/26

obligations.description: Treated effluent must meet prescribed discharge/reuse standards before release or reuse
obligations.capa_trigger: Any parameter exceeds CTO-prescribed limit

obligations.description: Effluent/water flow meters must be calibrated and log maintained
obligations.capa_trigger: Calibration overdue or drift beyond tolerance

obligations.description: Valid CTO must be held and renewed before expiry for water-related discharge
obligations.capa_trigger: Consent nearing expiry within lead-time window without renewal filed

obligations.description: Self-assessed water consumption cess return, where applicable
obligations.capa_trigger: Return not filed within due date

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.act_name: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.primary_instrument: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 21
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Any premises operating an 'air pollutant' emitting source (DG sets, boilers) above notified capacity thresholds

instrument_spo_chain.o: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 21

instrument_spo_chain.s: Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 21
Consent to Establish (CTE) / Consent to Operate (CTO) — Section 21

obligations.description: Stack emissions from DG sets must remain within CPCB/SPCB notified limits
obligations.capa_trigger: Any parameter exceeds notified limit

obligations.description: Boiler stack emissions must remain within prescribed limits
obligations.capa_trigger: Exceedance of prescribed limit

obligations.description: Ambient air quality at site boundary must meet National Ambient Air Quality Standards
obligations.capa_trigger: Any parameter exceeds NAAQS

obligations.description: DG set stack height must meet CPCB norm relative to DG capacity/building height
obligations.capa_trigger: Stack height below norm at inspection

obligations.description: Valid CTO must be held and renewed for air-emission sources
obligations.capa_trigger: Consent nearing expiry without renewal filed

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.administering_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) / CPCB
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.primary_instrument: Umbrella statute — enabling framework for all subordinate Rules below
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Applies to every establishment; gives rise to the subordinate Rules (HWM, SWM, Plastic, Noise, E-Waste, Battery, BMW, C&D)

instrument_spo_chain.o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) / CPCB
Umbrella statute — enabling framework for all subordinate Rules below

instrument_spo_chain.s: Umbrella statute — enabling framework for all subordinate Rules below
Umbrella statute — enabling framework for all subordinate Rules below

obligations.description: Annual environmental statement summarizing water/air/waste performance must be filed
obligations.capa_trigger: Not filed by statutory deadline

obligations.description: Bore-well water extraction requires CGWA No-Objection Certificate and periodic reporting
obligations.capa_trigger: NOC expired or extraction beyond permitted quantum

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.act_name: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Any establishment generating, storing, or transporting hazardous waste (used oil, e-waste, batteries, chemical residues)

obligations.description: Hazardous waste must not be stored beyond the permitted duration without SPCB extension
obligations.capa_trigger: Waste stored beyond 90 days without extension

obligations.description: Used oil from DG sets must be handed over to an authorized recycler with a manifest
obligations.capa_trigger: Disposal to unauthorized party or missing manifest

obligations.description: Hazardous waste must be segregated by category and labelled per Schedule III
obligations.capa_trigger: Mixed/unlabelled waste found at inspection
obligations.report_type: Internal NC log; feeds Annual Return

obligations.description: Valid Rule 6 authorization must be held and renewed
obligations.capa_trigger: Authorization nearing expiry without renewal filed

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.primary_instrument: Bulk Waste Generator Registration / Segregation Compliance
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Any establishment generating solid waste above the 'bulk generator' threshold (most hotels/hospitals qualify)

instrument_spo_chain.o: Bulk Waste Generator Registration / Segregation Compliance

instrument_spo_chain.s: Bulk Waste Generator Registration / Segregation Compliance
Bulk Waste Generator Registration / Segregation Compliance

obligations.description: Solid waste must be segregated at source into wet, dry and domestic-hazardous streams
obligations.capa_trigger: Mixed waste found at collection point
obligations.report_type: Internal NC log; feeds ULB compliance report

obligations.description: Registration as a bulk waste generator with the local body, with a waste management plan on file
obligations.capa_trigger: Registration lapsed or plan not updated

obligations.description: On-site wet waste processing (composting/biogas) volumes must be logged where mandated
obligations.capa_trigger: Processing capacity shortfall vs. generation

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Applies to premises adjoining or within notified zones (commercial/industrial/silence)

obligations.description: Boundary noise levels must remain within notified day/night limits for the applicable zone
obligations.capa_trigger: Reading exceeds notified limit for zone

obligations.description: DG sets must be housed in acoustic enclosures maintained to manufacturer/CPCB spec
obligations.capa_trigger: Enclosure damaged or missing

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Brand owners/users of plastic packaging above notified thresholds (F&B outlets, amenities packaging)

obligations.description: Identified single-use plastic items (notified list) must not be used or distributed on-site
obligations.capa_trigger: Prohibited SUP item found in use
obligations.report_type: Internal NC log; feeds EPR return

obligations.description: Plastic packaging use must be registered on the CPCB EPR portal with an annual return
obligations.capa_trigger: Return not filed or EPR targets unmet

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.primary_instrument: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) — for bulk consumers
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Establishments disposing of end-of-life electronic/IT equipment as bulk consumers

instrument_spo_chain.o: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) — for bulk consumers

instrument_spo_chain.s: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) — for bulk consumers
Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) — for bulk consumers

obligations.description: End-of-life electronics must be handed to an authorized dismantler/recycler with a manifest
obligations.capa_trigger: Disposal to unauthorized party

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Establishments using DG-set/UPS batteries above bulk-consumer threshold

obligations.description: Used lead-acid/other batteries must be returned to an authorized collection agency
obligations.capa_trigger: Battery disposed outside take-back channel

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres and any healthcare facility generating bio-medical waste

obligations.description: Bio-medical waste must be segregated into colour-coded bags/containers per category
obligations.capa_trigger: Wrong category or unsegregated waste found
obligations.report_type: Internal NC log; feeds Annual Report

obligations.description: Waste must be handed to the Common Bio-medical Waste Treatment Facility with a barcoded manifest
obligations.capa_trigger: Manifest mismatch or handover delay beyond 48 hours

obligations.description: On-site autoclaving, where used, must meet validated time/temperature/pressure parameters
obligations.capa_trigger: Cycle parameters outside validated range

obligations.description: Valid Rule 10 authorization must be held and renewed
obligations.capa_trigger: Authorization nearing expiry without renewal filed

cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.act_name: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.primary_instrument: Waste Management Plan for C&D activity
cpcb_regulatory_spo_map.applicability_trigger: Applies during renovation, refurbishment, or demolition activity generating C&D waste above threshold

instrument_spo_chain.o: Waste Management Plan for C&D activity

instrument_spo_chain.s: Waste Management Plan for C&D activity
Waste Management Plan for C&D activity

obligations.description: A waste management plan must be filed and executed for renovation/demolition activity
obligations.capa_trigger: C&D waste disposed without an approved plan

meta.scope: Core CPCB / MoEFCC-administered statutes and rules relevant to a 100-site hospitality and healthcare portfolio in India
meta.note: Section/Rule references are given at the instrument level (e.g. 'Section 25/26 consent', 'Rule 6 authorization') which are stable, well-established references. Exact clause numbers, monitoring frequencies and numeric limits vary by state PCB and CPCB category (Red/Orange/Green/White) and are amended periodically — validate against the current gazette text and each site's actual consent order before operational use. This is a structural/operating model, not a legal opinion.
